# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are prioritized for the latest published release of each supported Minecraft workspace:

| Minecraft | Loaders |
|-----------|---------|
| 1.20.1 | Fabric, NeoForge |
| 1.21.1 | Fabric, NeoForge |
| 26.1.2 | Fabric, NeoForge |

Older mod versions may not receive patches.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security issues privately through [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/MeherBenSalem/Mob-Loot-Bags/security/advisories/new).

Do not open a public issue or pull request with exploit details before maintainers have had a chance to investigate and release a fix.
